title: Generic strict semilinear system constructions and representative normalization
statement: For a small site $J$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and a strict inverse tower $B_n$ of commutative ring sheaves, define its generic strict semilinear system model as module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the ring $B_\bullet(n,U)=B_n(U)$ on the vertical sequence topology [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], with its actual tower restrictions. Its ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] uses unbounded cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and the standard quasi-isomorphism localization. Define evaluation by restriction to the vertical slice and the identity coefficient identification; coefficient restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] uses the actual composites of the tower maps. Evaluation and scalar restriction are additive and exact and are localized termwise; composition of scalar restrictions is identified by the identity on underlying section groups. The horizontal module maps give the transition transformation. Define derived reduction as its transpose under the scalar adjunction [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], normalized by the ordinary scalar-insertion unit and its K-flat representative comparison. A system is cartesian when all reductions are isomorphisms, including the equality indices. Compatible morphisms of towers give the actual sectionwise ring map and the identity-on-sections restriction comparison. Use the recorded internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and closed tensor representative models [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. For an exact functor between two such ringed module categories and a displayed derived tensor comparison, a representative normalization consists of ordinary tensor comparison isomorphisms, a map from the total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] of the two image complexes to the image of their total tensor whose restriction to each total-degree summand is exactly the inverse ordinary comparison followed by the image of the actual summand inclusion, preservation of K-flat representatives [def-pc-kflat-complex] with flat terms [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and the equality of its localization with the displayed derived comparison under the recorded K-flat comparison isomorphisms. Ordinary tensor sections are constructed by the actual sheafification unit applied to pure tensors. This is a normalization of existing tensor and scalar constructions, with independent site-object, morphism and coefficient universes; no new tensor operation or hypothesis on coefficient flatness is introduced.
